matches.eligibility_summary: For uninsured and underinsured patients who get medically necessary care. Open to residents of New York State, bordering states, or Ohio with household income at or below 400% of the Federal Poverty Level, regardless of immigration status. Discount on self-pay balances: 100% at 200% FPL or less, 90% at 201-300%, 80% at 301-400%. Only services by Catholic Health employed providers are covered; other doctors bill separately. Uninsured patients must also apply for any other assistance they may be eligible for.
matches.next_step: Fill out the New York State uniform financial assistance application and send proof of income (such as recent pay stubs or tax return). Mail to Catholic Health/RMC, 144 Genesee Street, 3rd Floor, Buffalo, NY 14203, Attn: Credit & Collections, or fax 716-961-4458. You have 240 days from your first billing statement to apply. While your application is reviewed you can set aside the bills. They decide within 30 days.

matches.why: ECMC (Erie County Medical Center) lists an income limit of 400% of the Federal Poverty Level. Your income is about 190.3% of it, so you may qualify. Confirm with the program.
matches.eligibility_summary: For low-income people without health insurance, people whose insurance is used up, and underinsured people (out-of-pocket medical costs over the past 12 months above 10% of gross yearly income), with household income up to 400% of the Federal Poverty Level. Immigration status does not matter. Charges reduced on a sliding scale: all charges waived below 200% FPL; at 200-300% FPL an uninsured patient pays a sliding amount up to 10% of what Medicaid would have paid, and an underinsured patient pays up to 10% of their insurance cost-sharing amount; at 301-400% FPL the same with a 20% maximum. These are the minimum discount rates on the form; ECMC may give more. You may be billed separately for physician fees not covered.
matches.contact: ECMC financial assistance office: (716) 898-5566. Extra help or appeals: Community Health Advocates 888-614-5400. State complaints: (800) 804-5447
matches.next_step: Fill out the NYS Uniform Hospital Financial Assistance Application and give ECMC proof of income. You can apply before an appointment, at the hospital, or when a bill arrives, even during collections. Return it in person or by mail to ECMC Financial Counseling Services, 462 Grider Street, Room 1101, Buffalo, NY 14215 (Mon-Fri, 7:30 a.m.-4:00 p.m.). ECMC sends a letter within 30 days. You can't be required to pay a bill while your application is being considered. Monthly payment plans are capped at 5% of gross monthly income.
